shortDescription: Ecuador's state-run oil company Petroecuador said on Friday it has lifted force majeure at a pumping station in the SOTE pipeline.It had resumed pumping through the pipeline on Thursday, after a fire last week affecting the Baeza pumping station.

children: Ecuador's state-run oil company Petroecuador said on Friday it has lifted force majeure at a pumping station in the SOTE pipeline.
It had resumed pumping through the pipeline on Thursday, after a fire last week affecting the Baeza pumping station.
